 required, and flush piping as needed.

text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, 
which must be performed on an annual bases as indicated by Y1 as indicated in 
the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Hassan Alsayed 
Abdelazez, tested by eng. Esmat Hassan Ibrahem at 21 Dec 2003, revised by WDEPCo. quality control eng. Mohamed Hesain Ibrahem, 
accepted by General Director eng. Hamdy Kamel Alsayes and approved by eng 
Mohamed Mahdy Rezq Alnashar: Head Sector of Sidi Kirir power station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance stuff should be carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
Tools and Equipment
Air blower.
Complete mechanical tool kit

 off G.R fan turning gear (oil heater) No. 1NHA 21A-ECH-28

Check visually damper blades and linkage; adjust if needed
Change oil of gear box turning gear motor.
Check visually housing, inlet box; adjust if needed.
Check visually rotor and blade liners.
Check visually rotor body bound bolts adjust if needed.
Check visually shaft bearing and seals; adjust / change if needed.
Check visually inlet cone clearance; adjust if needed.
Re-grease turning gear coupling.
